text:
Nikita Kucherov told the Lightning at the end of October that he won't re-sign and asked for a trade, according to an AP source, and the rumour mill has settled on Montreal: Yahoo Sports and Montreal Hockey Fanatics both ran Canadiens headlines on Nov. 25. Meanwhile the reigning Hart Trophy winner keeps producing like nothing is going on, with 33 points (10 goals) in 24 games and a four-game point streak.

Our numbers say the level is real but the totals are a little inflated. His team has scored 6.4 more goals than its chances deserved with him on the ice, the kind of on-ice luck that fades. The engine underneath is not luck: Evolving-Hockey had him second among 401 forwards in wins above replacement last season, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking put him in the 96th percentile for setting up shots. Our numbers project about 125 points. The thing to watch now is less the scoresheet than the calendar, and which sweater he wears when it turns.
headline: Kucherov wants out, and he is still dominating
